event_name: Time 17:18 2018 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 18 - 21 October 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 48), summoned (document 49) and heard the team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 20 consumed more than 105 kg of fuel during the race.
offence: Breach of Article 30.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representatives. The Stewards find that the amount of fuel consumed exceeded 105 kg during the race.
rules_referenced: Article 30.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 52 2018 United States Grand Prix Offence Car 20 Fuel Consumption
